values.note: Book online (Bonfire, linked as 'BOOK A CAMPSITE') or call the State Fair Event Center, (304) 645-1090, Mon-Fri 8 am-4 pm; after-hours arrivals leave a voicemail. During the Annual State Fair camping is by wait list. Refunds only if requested 15 days before the stay per the camping page; the Bonfire confirmation says 'No refunds on a cancelled campsite'. Check-in 12 PM, check-out 11 AM.

note: State Fair of WV (nonprofit) fairgrounds at Fairlea (Greenbrier Co), 3 mi off I-64. Hundreds of sites (175+ full-hookup, big-rig friendly) plus partial/electric/dry. Pass-through camping bookable outside fair dates. Not waterfront. Rates/availability change during the fair and events. Campground entrance is just past the red-roofed ticket booth tower, not at the 'Fairgrounds Parking' sign. --Claude
summary: Confirmed seasonal (generally closed early Nov - late Mar), full hookups, reservable (Bonfire online or phone) and the Good Sam 10% discount (not during the fair). Added wifi, bathhouse-on-request note, booking details. Fees $45 left as recorded (an undated rate line, see flag). Ownership private confirmed (501(c)(3)). Note: dropped the seasonal restatement, added the entrance direction.
flags: Rate date: the $45 full-hookup rate sits on a camping page whose header still says 'Open April 1, 2021 – October 31, 2021', so the rate may date from 2021; the Bonfire engine (reCAPTCHA, not automated) would give a current price. Base $45 is under the US$50 gate either way; no gateway within 40 km (nearest New River Gorge NP 63 km), family has not stayed here.
Entry has no phone: the State Fair Event Center is (304) 645-1090 (camping page, Bonfire).

Ownership confirmed private: 'The State Fair of West Virginia is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization' - no government operator shown. Nights outside fair week are sold to travellers ('perfect choice for overnight camping ... if you're just traveling through'); fair-week camping is wait-list only.
